# Data

* `samples/` — synthetic test images generated by `python tools/make_samples.py` (used by the tests and
  for a quick demo without a camera). They are **not** training data.
* `runtime/` — created automatically: the SQLite database (`freshgrade.db`) and saved inspection images.
  Delete this folder to reset the application.

## Training data sources (fill in as you download — required for the References section)

| Dataset | Used for | Classes | Licence | URL | Downloaded by / date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Roboflow Universe "fruits segmentations" | YOLO segmentation (M1) | Apple, Orange, Banana, Tomato, Lemon | CC BY 4.0 (check page) | https://universe.roboflow.com/wisd-ai1q6/fruits-segmentations | |
| Kaggle "Fruits fresh and rotten for classification" | Condition classifier (M2) | fresh/rotten apple, banana, orange | see Kaggle page | | |
| Healthy-Defective-Fruits (GitHub) | Classifier + defect tuning (M2) | apple/mango: fresh, bruise, rot, scab, black spot | see repository | https://github.com/luischuquim/Healthy-Defective-Fruits | |
| Mendeley "Fresh and Rotten Fruits Dataset" | Extra variety (M2) | 16 fresh/rotten classes | see page | https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/bdd69gyhv8 | |
